```yaml
name: Rust Web Build

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["rust-windows"]
    types:
      - completed

jobs:
  build-wasm:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' && github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' && github.event.workflow_run.repository.full_name == 'gents83/INOX' }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download native artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: native
          path: artifacts

      - name: Setup Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          target: wasm32-unknown-unknown
          components: rust-src
          override: true

      - name: Install Rust problem matchers
        uses: r7kamura/rust-problem-matchers@v1.1.0

      - name: Build WASM
        run: |
          cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
          mkdir -p target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/assets
          cp -r artifacts/* target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/assets/

      - name: Upload WASM artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: wasm
          path: target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/
```
